title: Arthur742Ramos/GraphCoveringTheory
abstract: Formalizes the sharp Schreier index formula for a finite-index subgroup of a free group on a finite nonempty generating type. For a finite nonempty type alpha, a subgroup H of FreeGroup alpha with finite index d is proved equivalent, as a group, to FreeGroup (Fin (1 + d * (card alpha - 1))). More strongly, the repository exposes a FreeGroupBasis for H with this indexing type. The proof realizes H as the vertex group of the finite action-groupoid covering on the coset space, verifies the covering locally by explicit star and costar bijections, and counts the complement of a geodesic spanning tree. It also exposes the truncation-safe natural-number statement and the generic finite free-groupoid rank calculation used by the submission theorem. For finite-index normal subgroups, a companion module proves that every deck transformation of the finite Schreier action is a unique right translation by the quotient group.
authors: Ruy J. G. B. de Queiroz
